requirements.evidence: "Recommendations should come from it (or from resources the user supplies), never from memory of a URL."

requirements.name: YouTube / podcast sites (links only)

notes: Read as text output of links from the catalog. If link checking by fetch were required, YouTube would be refused (outside the allow-list) and the verdict would be BLOCKED.
